findings.title: Tie the message codec’s snapshot type to its wire schema
findings.claim: The generic codec can claim any snapshot type without proving that its wire schema validates that type.
findings.why: When R-1b adds the duel codec, TypeScript would accept a duel snapshot type paired with the wrong snapshot header schema, and decoded publications would carry a false type.
findings.fix: Make ModeWire generic over the snapshot header and have codecFor derive or check its snapshot type from that schema; remove the unchecked decode cast.
